name: Freedom Tower
note: Authored interpretation: two-storey base, slender shaft, open belfry and stepped cupola. Coordinate-to-footprint match manually checked; preserve its silhouette.

name: Kaseya Center
note: Authored interpretation: pale oval outer rim, exposed bowl and tiered seating. Roof largely lost. Coordinates matched to the large waterfront footprint.

name: Miami Beach Convention Center
note: Long exhibition halls with public-edge fins, open columns and surviving upper gallery. Bay rhythm abstracts the reference facade.

name: Alfred I. duPont Building
note: Survey A includes a broader block. Narrow the upper masonry bar, keep vertical ribs, a heavy cornice and a broken corner.

name: SLS South Beach (former Ritz Plaza)
note: Direct footprint label, corrected to 62.2 m from the City of Miami Beach height exhibit and 12 storeys from the renovation architect. The historic photograph confirms the tall shaft and stepped crown.

name: Panorama Tower
note: OSM 265 m anchors the Brickell skyline. Narrow shaft and broad podium; lower eight floors climbable.

name: The Loft 2
note: The direct use label is a transit station; its 132 m measured height and name identify the tower above the transit passage.

name: Gesu Church
note: Reference-led church nave, raised central bell tower and clay roof courses. Box abstraction of the three-part front, without invented arches.

name: Historic Lyric Theater
note: Reference-led narrow stage house, twin front piers, raised centre parapet and broad balcony. No lettering or ornament copied.
